baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَوْفُوا بِٱلْعُقُودِ joins full, deficit-free completion to tied and ratified bonds.
baseline_models.mechanism: Faith supplies trusted ground, the contract joins parties and terms, and fulfillment carries the joined whole to completion without deficit.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling security supplies the trust condition in which obligations can bind without betrayal.
Deficit-free completion supplies the required motion: carry the bond to wholeness.
Tying ends together gives the contract a material topology of joined parties and terms.
Ratified obligation narrows the knot image to a covenant that exerts a claim on its parties.

changed_reading.after: Bring every trust-bearing bond, with all joined parties and terms, to completion without letting any part fall away.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُحِلَّتْ ... غَيْرَ مُحِلِّى ... وَأَنتُمْ حُرُمٌ layers release, exception, pursuit, and protected status.
baseline_models.mechanism: Permission is an authorized untying of restraint, not a flat absence of restraint; exception and consecrated status can keep a particular pursuit bound.

activation_trace.role: Untying a knot gives both the passive grant and the prohibited self-release a common mechanical image.
Dissolution of a ban distinguishes authorized release from making a restricted act available for oneself.
Difference and exception cut a bounded channel through the general grant.
Seeking and taking resistant prey identifies the acquisitive motion that must stop under the stated status.
Entry into consecration supplies a temporary status whose protections override an otherwise available pursuit.

changed_reading.before: Livestock is permitted, but hunting is forbidden during consecration.
changed_reading.after: Lawfulness is a controlled release: a general opening remains traversed by exceptions, and status can rebind a specific pursuit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَهِيمَةُ ٱلْأَنْعَامِ إِلَّا مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ couples provision to a qualification that follows.
baseline_models.mechanism: An undifferentiated living class is received as livestock and bounty, but following recitation travels with the grant and keeps its boundaries open to specification.

activation_trace.role: The non-discriminating living creature supplies the broad animal class before legal differentiation.
Livestock wealth identifies the concrete provision opened to use.
Beneficence lets the livestock grant register as favor rather than bare inventory.
Following in sequence makes recited qualification accompany and continue the general permission.

changed_reading.before: A class of animals is allowed except for items named elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Provision is genuinely opened, yet the opening is not self-sealing: the qualification that follows remains attached to how the gift may be used.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ closes the permission sequence with judgment joined to will.
baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment restrains and redirects motion as a bridle does, while will supplies the chosen direction; the split mapping of will also keeps prevention and turning-back live.

activation_trace.role: Prevention for repair gives judgment a practical function of checking corrupt motion.
The bridle around an animal's jaws supplies an exploratory material image for governing pursuit.
Will and intention provide the direction implemented by judgment.
The split-root image of repelling and preventing keeps a secondary reading in which willing is visible through what rule turns back.

changed_reading.after: Divine willing arrives here as governance that opens, checks, and redirects pursuit, although the bridle image remains exploratory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social capacity to assist can carry either good or transgression, while the completion of religion and blessing mirrors the focus demand for full performance. Contract fidelity therefore preserves a complete order collectively, especially where hostility tempts boundary-crossing.

activation_trace.role: Deficit-free fulfillment supplies the human-side motion toward wholeness.
Ratified obligation supplies the bond whose integrity collective action can preserve or violate.
Crossing a limit supplies the failure mode that hostility and wrongful cooperation can produce.
Mutual assistance supplies the distributed force by which a community completes good or amplifies breach.
Completion of the religion echoes fulfillment as bringing a structured whole to maturity.
Bringing blessing to its full measure supplies the divine-side completion that answers the opening imperative.

structural_cues: 5:2 repeats cooperation once toward birr and taqwa and once toward sin and aggression; the same social capacity can preserve or violate bonds.
5:3 places completion of religion and completion of blessing inside the unfolding food-law sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human cooperation, transgression, and divine completion; I infer a reciprocal arrow in which human fulfillment answers and preserves a completed gift. A live alternative is that the two kinds of completion are adjacent but not reciprocal.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment is each party's private compliance with an agreement.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment is collective maintenance of a complete covenantal order, tested by whether shared power serves good or crosses limits under hostility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next permissions are mediated rather than raw: trained hunters hold prey for another, and intimate access is enclosed by chastity, recognized bond, and compensation. Lawful release thus contains learned restraint and accountable custody.

activation_trace.role: Release from prohibition supplies the permission whose internal discipline the context makes visible.
Taking resistant prey supplies the appetite-driven acquisition that training must govern.
Knowledge made available to the knower supports the repeated teaching that converts predatory capacity into a directed instrument.
Holding and restraining the catch places inhibition inside the very act of acquisition.
Protection through bond or inviolability supplies a recognized enclosure for intimate permission.
Compensation for an obligation makes the transfer accountable rather than clandestine taking.

structural_cues: 5:4 repeats teaching around hunting and says the trained animal holds the catch for the addressee.
5:5 repeats lawful food reciprocally, then contrasts chaste bond with fornication and secret partners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trained acquisition, holding, protected intimacy, and compensation; I infer that these domains share a mechanism of permission made lawful by disciplined custody. They may alternatively remain separate legal examples without a common mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The animal grant is a broad permission narrowed by external exceptions.
changed_reading.after: Lawful access is also produced internally by training, restraint, protected relation, and accountable transfer; permission is not identical with ungoverned appetite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit contrast in 5:6 states what divine willing does locally: it rejects constriction as the aim, seeks purification, and brings blessing to completion. This supplies a purposive direction for the focus verse's otherwise open-ended judgment and will.

activation_trace.role: Preventive judgment supplies the governing action whose purpose the later contrast clarifies.
Will and intention pose the baseline question of what direction divine rule seeks.
Removal of impurity supplies the positive transformation sought through the ritual directions.
Repeated willing explicitly contrasts a rejected aim with the intended aim.
Constriction supplies the purpose explicitly negated, preventing restriction from becoming its own end.
Completion supplies the constructive endpoint of the imposed practice.
Blessing identifies what the rule completes rather than diminishes.

structural_cues: 5:6 grammatically contrasts 'does not will ... constriction' with 'but wills ... purify you and complete His blessing.'
The contrast follows detailed bodily rules and an accommodation when water is unavailable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit local contrast of purposes; I carry that purpose backward to characterize 5:1's judgment as ordered toward purification and completed benefit. The alternative is that 5:6 explains only ablution and does not delimit every act of divine will.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause asserts unrestricted divine choice after a list of permissions and bans.
changed_reading.after: Within this legal sequence, divine judgment is purposive governance: it blocks corruption without making constriction the goal, and directs practice toward purification and completed blessing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contract knot expands from spoken assent into an embodied public discipline: a confirmed covenant, upright equitable witness under hostility, and hands that can be extended in violence or restrained.

activation_trace.role: Tied ends supply the bond that later speech, witness, and bodily action must keep joined.
The confirmed covenant identifies 'we hear and obey' as an explicit enactment of the opening bond.
The straight balance supplies a public measure for testimony that does not bend with group feeling.
Justice in judgment supplies the repeated corrective action required precisely toward a hated group.
An extended and released hand supplies the bodily form of threatened aggression.
Restraint and prevention turn the aggressive hand back and preserve the community.

structural_cues: 5:6 first disciplines faces and hands in purification; 5:11 then narrates hostile hands extended and restrained.
The hostility test from 5:2 returns in 5:8 as a command to maintain justice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant speech, impartial witness, and the extension and restraint of hands; I infer that fulfillment is embodied across speech, judgment, and force. The hand sequence may be thematic choreography rather than a direct semantic gloss on contracts.

changed_reading.before: Contracts are fulfilled by honoring their stated terms.
changed_reading.after: The covenant is kept through a whole public posture: obedient speech, straight witness, impartial judgment, and restraint of the hand when hostility invites breach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant narratives expose an inverse process to fulfillment: undo what was made firm, turn words away from their direction and placement, and abandon a remembered share. The resulting hardening and enmity make breach a decomposition of structure and memory, not only a single prohibited act.

activation_trace.role: Whole completion supplies the positive process reversed by the later losses.
Tying and joining supply the structure that breach progressively dismantles.
The confirmed covenant establishes that the later damage acts on an already strengthened bond.
Undoing a firmly built thing supplies the direct mechanical inverse of the focus contract knot.
Turning away from a direction supplies the distortion applied to words.
A thing's assigned place supplies the arrangement from which words are displaced.
Abandoning and neglecting supplies the memory-level loss that follows structural undoing.
A due share identifies the portion of reminder allowed to fall out of the whole.

structural_cues: 5:13 orders breach, hardening, word displacement, and forgetting before the command to pardon and overlook.
5:14 repeats confirmed covenant and forgotten share, then places enmity and hatred between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered cluster of undoing, displacement, forgetting, and hostility; I infer a decomposition chain from damaged bond to damaged transmission to damaged relation. These may instead be parallel consequences rather than a strict causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: To fulfill a contract is mainly to avoid openly violating it.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment also preserves the bond's architecture and memory: terms must remain in place, the whole share must remain transmissible, and neglected fragments can become social fracture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later clarification answers concealment and forgotten portions with disclosure and light. This activates the focus clause 'except what is recited to you' as an ongoing corrective channel that keeps a general permission answerable to what is newly made manifest.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence lets recitation remain temporally attached to the general grant.
A remainder following what came before supports recitation as supplementation rather than a closed prior list.
Making meaning clear through speech supplies the corrective act performed on concealed scriptural material.
Concealment supplies the informational obstruction that disclosure must overcome.
Illumination supplies the transition from hidden qualification to inspectable guidance.
Renewed clarification after an interval confirms disclosure as a continuing intervention.

structural_cues: 5:13-14 twice mention a forgotten share of reminder before 5:15 says the messenger clarifies much that was concealed.
5:19 places renewed clarification after a gap in messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgotten portions, concealment, clarification, and light; I infer that the focus recitation is a standing corrective to self-sealed permission. The immediate syntax can still refer more narrowly to a finite dietary list.

changed_reading.before: The exception points to prohibitions recited in another place.
changed_reading.after: The recited exception also functions as corrective disclosure: permission remains revisable by what follows, recovers a neglected share, and brings hidden limits back into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final movement reverses the opening restraint. A prescribed entry into purified space is refused by turning backs and sitting; the result is exclusion and wandering. Covenant fidelity therefore calibrates motion by status: suspend acquisitive pursuit when consecrated, but advance through a commanded threshold when the bond requires entry.

activation_trace.role: Pursuit and taking supply the motion that consecrated status rightly suspends.
Consecrated status supplies a temporary reason for restraint in the focus ayah.
Entry into an interior supplies the positive movement now required by covenant.
A purified place supplies the sacred spatial destination rather than a status of immobility.
An established prescription supplies the obligating force behind entry.
Returning to a prior direction supplies the warned-against reversal.
Turning the back makes refusal a bodily reorientation away from the commanded destination.
The gate supplies the concrete threshold through which trust must become movement.
Sitting out an action supplies the misplaced restraint that violates rather than honors the command.
Deprivation and loss of the desired good turn sacred access into prolonged exclusion after refusal.

structural_cues: 5:21 commands entry and forbids turning back; 5:22-24 answer with conditional delay and finally permanent refusal and sitting.
5:26 converts refusal into forty years of wandering in the land; ت ي ه at word 7 is branchless and is used only as this structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite motion commands and their consequence; I infer a status-sensitive rule that covenant determines when restraint or advance is faithful. The movement pattern may dramatize obedience without being a direct lexical expansion of hunting.

changed_reading.before: The focus clause simply suspends hunting during a sacred state.
changed_reading.after: Covenant governs direction itself: restrain acquisitive pursuit when consecration binds it, but do not mistake passivity for piety when the same covenant commands entry through a threshold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads distinct legal and narrative domains through material topology. It remains anchored in the focus knot and untying roots and is reinforced by branch-backed undoing, gate, and deprivation. Render it as an exploratory organizing image, not as a claim that every rule reduces to spatial mechanics.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places عُقُود, two forms of ح ل ل, exception, and حُرُم in one compact sequence of binding and release.

activation_trace.role: Tied ends supply the basic topology of obligation.
Untying supplies the opposite operation by which access opens or is wrongly opened.
Undoing a firm construction shows breach as destructive unbinding.
The gate supplies a threshold where an established bond should authorize passage.
Deprivation supplies the topology's reversed outcome: failed obligation closes access.

changed_reading.before: Contracts, food permissions, ritual restraint, and land entry are adjacent legal topics.
changed_reading.after: They can be carried as a live topology: bind obligations, untie beneficial access, preserve status-sensitive thresholds, and recognize that destructive unbinding can close space into exclusion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant split-root image of remaining debt inside recitation. It remains anchored to يُتْلَىٰ and its primary branch of a right that follows its bearer, then gains context from forgotten shares and concealment. Downstream prose should mark it as a lexical experiment, not substitute 'debt' for the ordinary sense of recitation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ follows the general animal grant as its exception-bearing remainder.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability that follows its bearer lets the recited qualification travel with the recipient of permission.
The split-root image of a remaining debt supplies the exploratory sense of an unsettled remainder after general release.
Neglect supplies the act by which a trailing obligation can be dropped from active memory.
A due share supplies the portion that remains owed to the remembered whole.
Concealment supplies the condition in which the trailing qualification must be disclosed again.

changed_reading.before: What is recited is a static cross-reference to exceptions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the recited exception behaves like a liability that follows the grant, carrying an unsettled share until disclosure restores it to view.

strongest_changes: 5:6 gives the open-ended divine will of 5:1 a local purposive direction: purification, completed blessing, and no constriction as an end in itself.
5:7-14 turns fulfillment from private compliance into embodied public justice and preservation of a covenant's wording, placement, and remembered whole.
5:20-26 reveals a movement reversal: the covenant can require stopping acquisitive pursuit or advancing through a sacred gate, while misplaced passivity produces exclusion and wandering.
summary.what_was_special: The four-pericope span let the opening knot-and-release grammar recur across food, purification, covenant breach, disclosure, and land entry. The focus ayah shifted from a compact legal list into a regulator of completion, disciplined access, information integrity, and directed movement.
remaining_uncertainties: The reciprocal link between divine completion and human fulfillment is coherent but reader-supplied.
The corrective-disclosure reading may exceed the immediate dietary syntax of مَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ.
The threshold and movement topology may be deliberate cross-pericope architecture or an abductive overlay.
